heading: Military medical cooperation arrangements among Five Eyes countries

tree.heading: Authority.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense may enter into a bilateral or multilateral memorandum of understanding or other formal agreement with one or more governments of the Five Eyes countries to support military medical cooperation or improve operational medical interoperability.

children.text: The term “Five Eyes countries” means the following:
The term “military medical cooperation” means any of the following:
Medical interoperability, including credentialing of health care personnel.
Medical education, training, exercises, and evaluation.
Medical research, development, trials, and evaluation.
Biodefense, including with respect to prevention, preparation, response, and investigation.
Medical logistics, including the recognition of MedCM, drugs and medical equipment.
Any other areas for cooperation designated by the Secretary of Defense.
The term “military medicine” means any of the following:
Chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear medical support.
Public health, health readiness, and force health protection.
Any other areas of military medicine designated by the Secretary of Defense.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 119–60, div. A, title VII, § 715(a), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 922.)
